projects.description: TextileStudio - Production-Scale Semantic Search EngineBuilt a comprehensive semantic search engine specifically designed for the textile industry, enabling efficient product discovery and similarity matching across massive image datasets.Key Highlights:- Architected distributed vector database using Milvus to handle 100TB+ textile image datasets with horizontal scaling across multiple nodes- Developed custom C extensions for image preprocessing and feature extraction, achieving millisecond-level similarity matching performance- Implemented advanced semantic search capabilities enabling textile manufacturers to find similar patterns, colors, and designs instantly- Designed hybrid edge-cloud infrastructure with intelligent caching strategies and query optimization for cost-effective operations- Built robust data ingestion pipeline handling diverse textile image formats and metadata with automated quality control- Created sophisticated indexing system supporting multi-modal search (visual similarity, text descriptions, material properties)- Implemented real-time search API with sub-100ms response times despite massive dataset scale- Developed custom embedding models fine-tuned specifically for textile pattern recognition and similarity detectionTech Stack: Go, Python, Milvus, Firebase, C Extensions, Custom Vector Embeddings, Distributed Systems, Edge Computing, Image Processing APIs

publications.title: Improving Accessibility for Dyslexic Impairments using Augmented Reality
publications.subtitle: IEEEXplore | 2019 International Conference on Computer Communication and Informatics (ICCCI -2019)
publications.description: Dyslexia is a learning disability that affects a wide demographic, across all age groups and regions. This impairment is highly subjective and varies from person to person, with a number of factors such as line height, font style, spacing and size (among a few) that affect the ease of readibility. There is a need for an easilty accessibility real-time solution that caters to this need of the dyslexic, such that it helps render the ease of legibility at the touch of the palm. Augmenta11y is the outcome of the research conducted for this cause, and is one such solution that leverages AR (Augmented Reality) in order to overcome these hindrances by enabling user-adjustment of background-text contrast ratio and text customization in real life. After testing the application, we received positive results with a 21.03% decrease in their overall reading time for the text passages.We presented this research at the 2018 India HCI Conference held in Bangalore.

publications.description: Real time ASL-Translator would be a video conferencing application which will detect American sign language and will convert it into English text. In today’s scenario after the pandemic, there is a need to understand the gestures while communicating using video conferencing. As most of the existing projects work only on predicting the individual letters and not the complete words it was quite challenging. In this work, real time ASL- Translator has been proposed and implemented that would provide a platform for video conferencing in real time scenario. For the same CNN model has been deployed on server side. The proposed solution results with 95% of accuracy.

projects.title: Genetic Algorithm, Evolutionary Algorithms for COVID-19 Vaccines
projects.description: In this research, an optimized deep learning method was proposed to explore the possibility and practicality of neural net-work applications in medical imaging. The method was used to achieve the goal of judging common pneumonia and even COVID-19 more effectively. Where, the genetic algorithm was taken advantage to optimize the Dropout module, which is essential in neural networks so as to improve the performance of typical neural network models. The experiment results demonstrate that the proposed method shows excellent performance and strong practicability in judging pneumonia, and the application of advanced artificial intelligence technology in the field of medical imaging has broad prospects.
